exportProcessing: Seven scene-layer exports are byte-for-byte copies of their generated source PNGs; no resizing, palette conversion, or alpha modification was applied.

The road export was made from the generated road source by thresholding alpha below 240 to transparent, setting retained pixels opaque, and mirroring the left half across the right half to create an exactly matching repeat edge. The unmodified generated input is retained alongside the eight canonical layer files.
The assembled preview applies proposed offsets to the distant hills and castle hill; those are not approved runtime coordinates.
knownLimitations: No background renderer, parallax loader, configuration, or asset tests exist in the inspected repository. Runtime dimensions, scaling, draw order, and alpha handling remain unverified.
The 1672x941 scene canvas is the common generated source size, not a confirmed game viewport. The 1920x1080 label in the supplied reference graphic is not confirmed by game code.
The preview hill offsets and castle-hill transform are proposals and need review against the actual battle layout and hero scale.
The town skyline is stylized; its exact architectural details and viewpoint have not been verified against a surveyed location reference.

The supplied brief flags a summer sunset and arched bridge in the reference as conflicting with earlier winter/Pust notes and an explicit bridge exclusion. The current repository files inspected do not resolve the conflict. The sunset palette is followed and no bridge is included pending direction.
